# `sand`

Sand for floors: fine grains rippled by the wind.

![sand](../images/sand.png)

Category: [grounds](../catalog.md#grounds).

Own size: 64 × 64 pixels. Parameters marked **layout** are expressed at this size and scale with the patch; **detail** parameters are real pixels and never scale. See [Layout and detail](../concepts.md#layout-and-detail).

## Parameters

### General

| Parameter | Type                            | Default                                        | Scale  | Description                                           |
| --------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `size`    | [width, height] of integers > 0 | `[64, 64]`                                     | —      | own size of the patch, in pixels                      |
| `palette` | array of CSS colors, at least 2 | `["#8a744e", "#ab9266", "#c7ae80", "#ddc79a"]` | —      | colors of the sand, from darkest to lightest          |
| `specks`  | number ≥ 0                      | `12`                                           | —      | dark grains and bits of shell per 32 × 32 pixels      |
| `grain`   | number in [0, 1]                | `0.08`                                         | detail | random brightness variation between pixels, in [0, 1] |
| `wetness` | number in [0, 1]                | `0`                                            | —      | damp sand, darker, in [0, 1]                          |

### `ripples`

Ripples left by the wind: a long lit slope, a short shadowed one.

| Parameter       | Type             | Default | Scale  | Description                                                                                              |
| --------------- | ---------------- | ------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ripples.count` | integer ≥ 0      | `5`     | layout | ripples down the patch; 0 for flat sand                                                                  |
| `ripples.slant` | integer          | `1`     | —      | ripples the crests shift by across the width: tilts them while the sand keeps tiling; 0 for level crests |
| `ripples.depth` | number in [0, 1] | `0.35`  | —      | shading of the ripples, in [0, 1]                                                                        |
| `ripples.warp`  | number in [0, 1] | `0.4`   | —      | waviness of the crests, in [0, 1]                                                                        |

## Usage

`sand` is a ground, for floors: fine grains, rippled by the wind. Each ripple has a long
lit slope and a short one in shadow. `ripples.count` ripples cross the patch downwards,
and `ripples.slant` shifts their crests across the width: both are whole numbers, so that
the sand tiles. `specks` strews darker grains, and `wetness` darkens it into wet sand.

```json
{ "template": "sand", "ripples": { "count": 4, "slant": 2 } }
```

## Example

```json
{
  "$schema": "../../schemas/patch.schema.json",
  "template": "sand",
  "size": [64, 64]
}
```
